Level 13 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Research

A repository of valuable books, maps, and scrolls, usually attached to a Library behind a locked or secret door.

Research: Helpful Lore. The hireling searches the Archive for 7 days and gains knowledge as if they had cast Legend Lore, which they share with you the next time you speak with them.

Reference Book. Your Archive holds one copy of a rare reference book, which gives you a benefit while you and the book are in your Bastion. Choose one of the following (your DM might offer others); each gives you Advantage on the listed check when you take the Study action to recall the listed lore.

  • Bigby's Handy Arcana Codex (Arcana): spells, magic items, eldritch symbols, magical traditions, and planes of existence.
  • The Chronepsis Chronicles (History): historical events, legendary people, ancient kingdoms, past disputes, wars, and lost civilizations.
  • Investigations of the Inquisitive (Investigation): deductions from clues or evidence, traps, ciphers, riddles, and gadgetry.
  • Material Musings on the Nature of the World (Nature): terrain, plants, animals, and weather.
  • The Old Faith and Other Religions (Religion): deities, rites and prayers, hierarchies, holy symbols, and secret cults.

Enlarging the Facility. For 2,000 GP, your Archive becomes Vast and gains two more reference books from the list above.
